propositions: jql_active query uses literal status != 'Done' instead of statusCategory != Done, causing issues with Closed/Resolved/Cancelled statuses from custom workflows to incorrectly appear in the active working set
jql_done_recent query uses literal status = 'Done' instead of statusCategory = Done, missing issues with custom done-equivalent statuses and failing to populate the recent-Done snapshot
Switching from literal status predicates to statusCategory-based predicates makes the reconciler query workflow-agnostic and compatible with any Jira status that maps to the Done category
JQL builder edits to fetcher.py must maintain fetcher.py at exactly 650 lines per test_fetch_paging_split.py::test_both_modules_under_the_size_target
Existing DIG/REB workflow behavior (using only To Do/In Progress/Done statuses) must remain unchanged after statusCategory refactoring
